meta.purpose: dash-jump trace: 30 idle frames so the respawn jump-suppression window (120ms) lapses (EVAL-P5-002), folded into this one replay call for the same reason as dash-basic.json, then dash right for 4 frames (a fresh input edge takes a frame to reach the body, matching dash-basic.json), hold jump for 4 frames (a short hop clears stage geometry), release jump, then run to the apex (47 steps total, the deterministic frame vy first reaches exactly 0 in this motor). The dash carries vx=320 unchanged through the whole flight, so the single end read stands in for both the former takeoff and apex velocity samples; the end x/y is asserted within 2px of a recorded reference.
